structured.answer: I won't decide alone. The page names Psagot with the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500" fund as the cheapest (86,492 ₪ from 70,000 ₪ put in over 10 years, against about 83,000 ₪ at Leumi and 81,000 ₪ at Hapoalim), so the banks look more expensive. But I don't know Psagot and saw nothing about safety, so I'll ask my son or the bank.
